youtube_title: Jesus... My Whole Future Is Behind One Result Page | Philippians 4:6 #Shorts
youtube_description:
Jesus... the result comes out tomorrow at ten. 😔

Tomorrow at ten a result page opens, and his whole future feels like it is hiding behind it.

He: Jesus... the result comes out tomorrow at ten. 😔

He: One login. One page. It decides where I live, what I earn, who I become.

Jesus: You refreshed the university site four times today knowing it wasn't updated yet.

He: I can't help it. Two years of my life are hiding behind that one button.

Jesus: The nights you studied when nobody clapped already happened. A webpage cannot un-happen them.

He: But what if the number isn't enough? What do I tell my parents?

Jesus: You tell them the truth, and I'll be standing beside you when the page loads either way.

He: I keep imagining both futures and my chest gets tight in both.

Jesus: Put both futures down tonight. I'm already in whichever one opens, and I don't love you differently in either.

Jesus: Sleep tonight. The page will still be there in the morning, and so will I.

"Be anxious for nothing, but in everything, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God."
Philippians 4:6 (BSB)

Put both futures down tonight. I'm already in whichever one opens, and I don't love you differently in either.

Jesus's Replies — the questions you actually ask, answered from Scripture.

What result are you waiting on? 🙏

An imagined reply. The Scripture is quoted as written.
